description: ApiService is an Angular injectable service that provides methods for managing authentication tokens and performing HTTP requests (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) with JSON payloads. It reads configuration from environment files and handles authorization headers and response processing.

classes.name: ApiService
classes.description: A service class that provides HTTP methods with token management and JSON support, designed for Angular applications.

methods.name: setToken
methods.description: Stores the JWT or bearer token in localStorage.

methods.name: clearToken
methods.description: Removes the auth token from localStorage and redirects to login page.

methods.name: getToken
methods.description: Retrieves the stored auth token from localStorage.

methods.name: headers
methods.description: Constructs HTTP headers including Content-Type and Authorization if token exists.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes an HTTP response, handling errors and parsing JSON or text responses.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs a GET request with optional query parameters, returning typed JSON.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs a POST request with a JSON body, returning typed JSON.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Performs a PUT request with a JSON body, returning typed JSON.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Performs a DELETE request, returning typed JSON.
